title: Young, Beginning and Small Farmer Program Discount Over the Life of the Line — Operating Lines of Credit
content:
The young, beginning and small farmer program discount on the Operating Lines of Credit is given in full for the first 60 whole months after a line is first booked; after that it tapers, and the taper depends on whether the member is still certified a beginning farmer.

## Rule

On the AutoDraft enrolment day, the program discount is:

- **0.5 times the product's program discount** when the member is certified a beginning farmer on an active Crop Insurance policy for the line's crop year and the line was first booked more than 60 whole months before the enrolment day;
- **0.25 times the product's program discount** when the member is not so certified and the line was first booked more than 60 whole months before;
- **the product's program discount** when the line was first booked no more than 60 whole months before.

The beginning-farmer certification is the one shown on the member's active Crop Insurance policy for the line's crop year. The first booking date is the booking date recorded on the line. The program discount so set is one of the rate discounts that are added together and capped at the product's discount cap.

## Discount by product (percentage points)

| Product | Product program discount | First booked no more than 60 whole months before | More than 60, certified beginning farmer | More than 60, not certified |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | 1.0 (1) | 1.0 | 0.5 | 0.25 |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit, Seasonal Operating Loan, Revolving Operating Line, Borrowing Base Operating Line, Agribusiness Revolving Line | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical StartRight Operating Line, enrolment on 1 March)

| Line first booked | Whole months before the enrolment day | Beginning-farmer certification on the crop-year policy | Program discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March, five years earlier | 60 | Not certified | 1.0 |
| 28 February, five years earlier | 60 | Not certified | 1.0 |
| 1 February, five years earlier | 61 | Certified | 0.5 |
| 1 February, five years earlier | 61 | Not certified | 0.25 |
